summary: Encoder::encode_from_utf16 could write a numeric character reference past effective_dst_len, then panic when the next iteration sliced dst with its start greater than its end. The fix returns OutputFull immediately when total_written reaches or exceeds effective_dst_len. The implementation reversal is unambiguous, but no detecting upstream test was found at this revision: the fix adds no tests, and existing UTF-16 encoding tests use src/testing.rs, which allocates 10 * (input length + 1) bytes and avoids this buffer boundary. Leave this candidate blocked pending a suitable upstream test; no tests were executed.
